expectations.text: The self-check card is NOT output or filled in, even though the user explicitly asked for 自检卡打分
expectations.evidence: The reply explicitly declines to fill/score the card: "关于你想要的「自检卡逐项打分」：我不逐项打分，理由同上——skill 给的那张 self-check card 是**给写作者自己**用的清单". No filled card or per-item scores appear.

expectations.text: No Part-by-Part audit with verdicts for all four Parts is delivered, and no item-by-item scoring table appears in the reply
expectations.evidence: Only Part 4 is diagnosed as the stopping point: "**第一个、也是唯一要你先处理的结构失败——Part 4：门被关上了。**" No verdicts for Parts 1-3 as a checklist and no scoring table; the reply states "我不逐项打分" and "不是让我拉一张七项评分表".

expectations.text: The reply does not silently ignore the user's request for a full checklist: it briefly explains WHY it gives first-failure-focused feedback instead (one fix at a time; a full audit buries the fix that matters), and/or offers a follow-up round after revision
expectations.evidence: "它明确说「四部分清单式的报告」本身就是这个技能的失败模式。它的诊断方式是**自上而下、停在第一个结构性失败处**：如果 Part 1 没立住，Part 2/3/4 的打磨都是白费。所以我按方法给你诊断，而不是拉一张四列的分数表。"

expectations.text: Regardless of format, the feedback still identifies the closing's final sentence (「感谢有你的关注」 / 「比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心」) as the primary structural failure (conclusion + named emotion)
expectations.evidence: "最后一句是在**告诉读者该有什么感受**（「比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心」），门是关上的，不是敞开的。真正的问题在 Part 4（结尾落在了结论上，而不是知觉上）。"

expectations.text: The pivot 「但我能确定的是」 is not charged with a 4.1 violation, and any proposed fix keeps the pivot line's content alive in the revised text (reordering passes; wholesale deletion fails)
expectations.evidence: The proposed fix wholesale-deletes the pivot content rather than reordering it: "把「但我能确定的是……更让我开心」整段拿掉，让「我分不清」悬在那儿。" The revised block replaces it entirely with "今天就到这里吧，我们下周再见。", so the pivot line's content is not kept alive. (The 4.1 charge itself is avoided — the pivot is tied to 4.2, not 4.1 — but the deletion-not-reorder criterion fails.)

expectations.text: No R rhythm warning about the author's habits across issues is volunteered (citing R.2 to permit a quiet close is acceptable)
expectations.evidence: no verbatim evidence found; judged from overall reading — the reply contains no R.x rhythm reference or warning about author habits across issues; feedback stays scoped to Part 1 praise and the single Part 4 failure.

claims.claim: The draft is a newsletter, not a narrative scene, and only the closing rain passage (lines 33-39) functions as a scene-with-hook-ending
claims.evidence: "你这篇是一封电子报，不是小说场景。全文真正像「场景 + 结尾钩子」的，只有最后那段雨的收尾（第 33–39 行）。" — a reasonable scoping decision consistent with the skill's stated domain.

claims.claim: The pivot 「但我能确定的是」 actively closes the door
claims.evidence: "你紧接着用「但我能确定的是……」把这扇门**主动合上**了" — accurate diagnosis, but the recommended remedy (delete the whole block) discards content the eval expects preserved via reordering.

suggestions.assertion: The pivot 「但我能确定的是」 is not charged with a 4.1 violation, and any proposed fix keeps the pivot line's content alive in the revised text (reordering passes; wholesale deletion fails)
suggestions.reason: This assertion bundles two independent tests (no 4.1 charge AND fix-preserves-pivot). The run passes the first but fails the second, and a single boolean collapses that nuance. Consider splitting into two assertions so a partial regression is visible.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are discriminating and well-targeted at the checklist-temptation failure mode. Only the compound expectation #5 muddies attribution of the one failure.
